- Be ready to grasp the athlete around the torso if they fail to maintain proper technique and/or complete a repetition
- If the athletes fails, wrap arms under their armpits and around their torso to help them return to an erect position (-17)
- If the spotter assists in a repetition, the athlete and spotter should walk the weight back to be racked (-18)
